query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM clients WHERE (id < $2) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE ($2 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", COALESCE(e.sequence, s.sequence) AS "sequence!", e.event AS "event?", CASE WHEN $3 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END AS "context?: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at AS "recorded_at?", p.payload as "forgettable_payload?", CASE WHEN e.sequence IS NULL OR e.sequence = s.sequence + 1 THEN s.snapshot END AS "snapshot?", s.sequence AS "snapshot_sequence?", s.recorded_at AS "snapshot_recorded_at?", s.first_recorded_at AS "snapshot_first_recorded_at?", sp.payload as "snapshot_forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i LEFT JOIN client_snapshots s ON s.id = i.id AND s.fingerprint = $4 LEFT JOIN client_events e ON e.id = i.id AND e.sequence > COALESCE(s.sequence, 0) LEFT JOIN clients_forgettable_payloads p ON e.id = p.entity_id AND e.sequence = p.sequence LEFT JOIN clients_forgettable_payloads sp ON sp.entity_id = i.id AND sp.sequence = 0 ORDER BY i.id desc, i.id, COALESCE(e.sequence, s.sequence)
